## Primary estimand

Delta (SIM minus RAND, adaptive) = 0.1652 rad, 95 % percentile bootstrap CI [0.1560, 0.1735] (10,000 resamples, seed 7), paired t CI [0.1546, 0.1758], d_z = 11.15, n = 10 seeds. Decision under the frozen rule: **reject H0**.

Pre-specified secondary, drift per accepted item, SIM minus RAND: 0.001581 rad per accepted track, 95 % CI [0.001489, 0.001664].
